mental_template|treatmentbasics|Medicati.description: Numeric score assigned to the medication adherence level.
mental_template|treatmentbasics|Medicati.definition: CASE TRIM(medadh) WHEN 'High' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 3 END

mental_template|treatmentbasics|Medicati.description: Numeric score assigned to the medication side effect severity.
mental_template|treatmentbasics|Medicati.definition: CASE TRIM(medside) WHEN 'Mild' THEN 0 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 1 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 2 END

mental_template|treatmentbasics|Crisis i.description: Composite crisis intervention score computed from adherence and side effect severity. Selects 17% of rows.
mental_template|treatmentbasics|Crisis i.definition: crisisint = (CASE TRIM(medadh) WHEN 'High' THEN 0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 3 END) + (CASE TRIM(medside) WHEN 'Mild' THEN 0 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 1 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 2 END)

mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris.description: GAD-7 anxiety score (0-21) extracted from the mental health scores JSON object
PHQ-9 depression score (0-27) extracted from the mental health scores JSON object
Overall suicide risk rating derived from the suicidal ideation category Selects 27% of rows.
mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris.definition: suicrisk = CASE TRIM(suicideation) WHEN 'Passive' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'Active' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'Plan' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Intent' THEN 'Severe' END

mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris.description: Substance use severity rating derived from primary substance use and frequency Selects 26% of rows.
mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris.definition: subusesev = CASE WHEN TRIM(subusefreq) = 'Daily' OR TRIM(subuse) = 'Opioids' OR TRIM(subuse) = 'Multiple' THEN 'Severe' WHEN TRIM(subusefreq) = 'Regular' OR TRIM(subuse) = 'Alcohol' THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Mild' END

mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris.description: Array of eight symptom scores extracted from the mental health scores JSON object

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Treatm.description: Treatment progress is derived from the treatment response rating. Selects 38% of rows.
mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Treatm.definition: TRIM(thprog) = CASE WHEN TRIM(txresp) = 'Good' THEN 'Good' WHEN TRIM(txresp) = 'Partial' THEN 'Fair' WHEN TRIM(txresp) = 'Poor' THEN 'Poor' END

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Goal s.description: The recorded goal status rating is the same as the treatment goal status. Selects 25% of rows.

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Treatm.description: The treatment satisfaction rating is categorized from the satisfaction score. Selects 26% of rows.
mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Treatm.definition: TRIM(txsat) = CASE WHEN satscr >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN satscr >= 5 THEN 'Medium' WHEN satscr >= 3 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Dissatisfied' END

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Signif.description: Both symptom improvement and functional improvement are rated significant. Selects 7% of rows.

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Succes.description: Favorable progress, response, goal achievement, symptom and functional improvement, and mild side-effect burden.

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Treatm.description: Treatment adherence or treatment engagement is rated non-compliant. Selects 42% of rows.

mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|Strong.description: The therapeutic alliance is rated strong. Selects 25% of rows.

mental_template|clinicians|Clinician con.description: Clinician confidence level derived from documentation status. Selects 32% of rows.
mental_template|clinicians|Clinician con.definition: clinconf = CASE WHEN docustat = 'Complete' THEN 'High' WHEN docustat = 'Incomplete' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END

mental_template|clinicians|Care coordina.description: Level of care coordination determined by referral need. Selects 35% of rows.
mental_template|clinicians|Care coordina.definition: carecoord = CASE WHEN refneed = 'Specialist' THEN 'Intensive' WHEN refneed = 'Testing' THEN 'Limited' ELSE 'Regular' END

mental_template|clinicians|Follow-up fre.description: Follow-up frequency determined by follow-up type. Selects 26% of rows.
mental_template|clinicians|Follow-up fre.definition: fupfreq = CASE WHEN fuptype = 'Urgent' THEN 'Weekly' WHEN fuptype = 'Therapy' THEN 'Biweekly' WHEN fuptype = 'Medication Check' THEN 'Monthly' ELSE 'Quarterly' END

mental_template|clinicians|Referral need.description: Referral need inferred from assessment limitation. Selects 29% of rows.
mental_template|clinicians|Referral need.definition: refneed = CASE WHEN assesslim = 'Cognitive' THEN 'Testing' WHEN assesslim = 'Language' THEN 'Specialist' ELSE 'Services' END

mental_template|clinicians|Billing code.description: Billing code mapped from follow-up type. Selects 1% of rows.
mental_template|clinicians|Billing code.definition: billcode = CASE WHEN fuptype = 'Therapy' THEN 'CPT90895' WHEN fuptype = 'Medication Check' THEN 'CPT90752' WHEN fuptype = 'Urgent' THEN 'CPT90879' ELSE 'CPT90210' END
